operation.description:
Gets GitHub Actions cache retention limit for an organization. All repositories under this
organization may not set a higher cache retention limit.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:organization` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Get GitHub Actions cache retention limit for an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-reten.description: GitHub Actions cache retention policy for an organization.

max_cache_retention_days.description: For repositories in this organization, the maximum duration, in days, for which caches in a repository may be retained.

#/components/schemas/actions-cache-reten.title: Actions cache retention limit for an organization
